'''Talia's necklace''' was a [[Necklace/Legends|necklace]] owned by [[Onderon/Legends|Onderon's]] [[Queen/Legends|Queen]] [[Talia (Onderon)|Talia]]. About [[3627 BBY|325 years later]], it was recovered as a valuable historical artifact and taken to [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]].<ref name="TOR" />

*''[[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic II: The Sith Lords]]'' {{1st}}
